texto: Print a worksheet from your Kit and trace the letter M with your finger, then with a pencil.
Make the letter A with beans or seeds on the table.
Put sand or salt on a tray and write your name with your finger.
Find three things at home that start with the letter P.
Help set the table and count how many spoons there are.
Find something at home shaped like a circle, a square and a triangle.
Ask someone to read you a story and find the letter O on a page.
Match the socks into pairs and count how many pairs you made.
Draw your family and write the first letter of each name.
Go outside and collect 10 leaves. Line them up from smallest to biggest.
Make the letters of your name with play dough.
Print a worksheet from your Kit and trace the letter S in your favorite color.
Build a tower with 10 things (cups, boxes or blocks), counting out loud.
Sort buttons, bottle caps or pebbles by color into three little piles.
Sing a song and clap once for every word.
In the bathroom, write the letter E on the foggy mirror.
Do a puzzle with someone in your family.
Water a plant and count its leaves.
Print a worksheet from your Kit and trace the letter L from top to bottom.
Walk around the room in the shape of a square.
In the kitchen, name some fruits and say which letter each one starts with.
Trace your hand on paper and write a letter on each finger.
Make a circle on the floor with a rope or ribbon and jump inside.
Print a worksheet from your Kit and practice your favorite cursive letter.
Find a box and count how many sides and corners it has.
Before bed, tell someone three words that start with the letter M.
Line up your toys from biggest to smallest.
Write a short letter with drawings for someone you love.
Cut out a paper star and count its points.
Print a worksheet from your Kit and write your name in cursive, one letter at a time.
